tagline: A calm, coastal Asian side neighbourhood between Maltepe and Bostancı — seafront promenades, a relaxed pace, and some of the most pleasant residential streets on the southern coast.

items.name: İdealtepe Sahili
items.description: A quiet stretch of the Marmara coastline with a promenade, benches, and sea views extending to the Princes' Islands. Best at sunset.
items.tip: Walk south along the coast towards Bostancı for a longer seafront stroll away from the busier sections.

items.name: Sahil Kafeleri
items.description: Small cafés along the seafront road with outdoor seating and views of the Marmara. A pleasant spot for a slow afternoon coffee.

items.name: Semt Lokantalari
items.description: Neighbourhood restaurants serving solid Turkish food at local prices — reliable, unpretentious, and popular with residents.

tips: İdealtepe is on the commuter rail (Marmaray) and close to Maltepe's M4 metro stop.
One of the quieter coastal neighbourhoods — a good choice if you want seaside living without the Bostancı or Caddebostan bustle.
Rents are lower here than in Bostancı or Caddebostan for nearly the same coastline access.
The seafront is lovely for an evening walk regardless of where you're based.
